chunks: Together with the hordes of Iblis.
ai.seo_question: Who are the hordes of Iblis mentioned in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the totality of Iblis's forces, highlighting that every demon and follower is united in opposition to divine truth. It serves as a reminder of the comprehensive nature of the spiritual battle, where no part of the enemy's host is excluded from the struggle against guidance.
